es: HQ Residences Miami es un condominio en preconstrucción en Edgewater, en 422 NE 29th St, Miami, FL 33137. Contempla 229 residencias en 35 pisos, de 1 – 3 habitaciones y de 721 – 2,074 sq ft.
Equipo: arquitectura de Arquitectonica; interiorismo de DesignAgency & Craft; paisajismo de Enzo Enea; desarrollo de Black Salmon. Entrega estimada: 2029. Precios desde $850,000.
en: HQ Residences Miami is a condominium in pre-construction in Edgewater, at 422 NE 29th St, Miami, FL 33137. It comprises 229 residences over 35 floors, with 1 – 3 bedrooms and of 721 – 2,074 sq ft.
Team: architecture by Arquitectonica; interiors by DesignAgency & Craft; landscape design by Enzo Enea; developed by Black Salmon. Estimated delivery: 2029. Prices from $850,000.
